context.title: Transport Workers Union Local 250A: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition H (Parcel Tax to Fund Public Muni Operations)

positions.statement: Transit Workers Union 250A and Transit Workers Union - 250A signed the argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition H and the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition H in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.
